description: This file provides functions and types for parsing and handling IRC protocol messages, including line parsing, prefix parsing, message sanitization, and ID generation.

methods.name: parseIrcLine
methods.description: Parses a raw IRC line into its components: prefix, command, parameters, and trailing message.

methods.name: parseIrcPrefix
methods.description: Parses an IRC prefix string into its components: nick, user, host, server.

methods.name: decodeLiteralEscapes
methods.description: Decodes common escape sequences in IRC message payloads.

methods.name: sanitizeIrcOutboundText
methods.description: Sanitizes outbound IRC text by decoding escapes and removing control characters.

methods.name: sanitizeIrcTarget
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes an IRC target string, ensuring it has no control characters and matches the pattern.

methods.name: splitIrcText
methods.description: Splits long IRC messages into chunks not exceeding a specified maximum length.

methods.name: makeIrcMessageId
methods.description: Generates a unique IRC message ID using UUID.
